verdict.rationale: Base44 docs describe built-in AI agents that act inside apps (updating records, triggering workflows, connecting to tools) as a native platform feature, implying no separate provider key setup is needed since it's part of the managed platform. However, there's no explicit documentation confirming key management is abstracted away or detailing generic 'LLM call' primitives beyond the agent feature. Missing for 10: explicit statement on API key/provider management abstraction, documentation of raw LLM call APIs beyond agents, and independent verification of ease-of-use for this specific capability.
